comedy.hook: A proudly flying muscular superhero strains while a man stands unknowingly below.
comedy.goal: The man wants the irresponsible flying culprit to answer for the mess.
escalation: A cartoon lump falls from the hero onto the man.
The furious man scolds through universal pointing and nonverbal cartoon bursts.
The enormous caped hero lands beside him and takes the insult personally.
comedy.payoff: Three real synchronized impact sounds and delayed squash/recoil lead to a comic fall.
comedy.callback: The ridiculous brown bonnet remains visible even after the superhero’s triumphant pose.

title: Captain Udaan: silent slapstick
story: A muscular blue-suited, red-caped hero poops while flying. It lands on a man. He angrily points and scolds in incomprehensible cartoon grunts. The hero lands, punches him three times with real impact SFX, and poses while the man blinks on the floor.

scenes.summary: A muscular caped hero poops while flying; the cartoon lump falls onto the man beneath him.

beats.intent: The caped hero flies horizontally above the street, strains briefly, releases a cartoon lump and cruises on.
The lump lands directly on his head. He flinches, freezes, then realizes what landed.
He slowly looks upward at the flying culprit, becoming furious.

scenes.summary: The furious man points upward and scolds through nonverbal cartoon bursts. The hero hears him and gets angry.

beats.intent: He raises a pointing finger toward the superhero above.
He angrily scolds the airborne hero while keeping the poop bonnet in view.
The hero hears the insult, lowers his gaze and gets angry.

scenes.summary: The powerful caped hero drops from the sky, lands beside the man and stares him down.

beats.intent: He descends vertically, plants both boots, compresses into a landing crouch and rises to full muscular height.
The man sees the enormous chest and starts regretting the insult.

scenes.summary: Three synchronized cartoon punches follow the complaint; the man falls while the muscular hero poses beside him.

beats.intent: He winds up and lands a clearly visible comic fist on the man’s cheek, then retracts.
His face squashes at contact and rebounds; the brown poop hat stays attached to his head.
